_comment: Base alt text per ring, written from Samantha's own product descriptions. Image 1 uses the base; later images append ', alternate view' since which angle each frame shows is unknown. These describe the PIECE accurately but are not a substitute for someone who has seen the photos — improve them in Keystatic when convenient.
